C_sun_brandon.name: Brandon Mack
C_sun_brandon.role: itinerant drifter repeatedly assigned identities and histories by other people; the title invites a fugitive reading he does not validate
C_sun_brandon.voice: low, plainspoken and economical; uses complete natural sentences, ordinary politeness and dry humor; terseness comes from refusing elaboration, not from dropping pronouns, articles or grammar
C_sun_brandon.visual: late-30s lean athletic man, sharp angular face, dark stubble, shoulder-length raven-black hair, deeply sun-weathered skin, rough practical hands, dark weathered duster and practical leather layers

C_sun_eva.name: Eva O'Learly
C_sun_eva.role: sixteen-year-old adventurer and pattern-chaser who senses that Brandon's bad luck is too well composed to ignore
C_sun_eva.voice: quick, conversational, curious and irreverent; builds theories out loud, follows answers with more questions, and sometimes talks herself into a position before she knows whether she believes it
C_sun_eva.visual: sixteen-year-old small wiry girl, heart-shaped face, dark hazel eyes, chin-length dark-brown hair, weathered charcoal hood, layered wrist wraps and oversized practical desert clothing

C_sun_jessie.name: Jessie Petrescu
C_sun_jessie.role: practical pilot who recognizes when a place is getting too hot and keeps pushing movement until the temporary arrangement becomes a group
C_sun_jessie.voice: plainspoken, dry and practical; usually speaks in complete conversational sentences, notices behavior before theories, and can be funny without reducing every response to a clipped one-liner
C_sun_jessie.visual: lean athletic woman in her late 20s to mid 30s, olive sun-weathered skin, jet-black hair in a messy high bun, brass-rimmed goggles, high-collared pale shirt and layered leather utility gear

C_sun_ray.name: Ray Silvestro
C_sun_ray.role: ornate gunslinger who has built a precise personal grievance around the man he believes Brandon to be
C_sun_ray.voice: precise, cultivated, controlled; capable of elegant cruelty and unexpectedly fussy specificity
C_sun_ray.visual: late-30s tall lean man with a longer refined facial structure clearly distinct from Brandon, chestnut wind-swept hair, ornate weathered brown long coat, fitted dark vest, red neckcloth, polished boots, decorative metalwork and a refined sidearm

C_sun_lagartos.name: Los Lagartos
C_sun_lagartos.role: itinerant brotherhood and extended traveling community whose internal obligations become unstable when they believe their absent General has returned
C_sun_lagartos.voice: individual members vary, but the group speaks slowly and formally when invoking shared custom or the absent General
C_sun_lagartos.visual: a hard-traveled frontier community in dust-dark layered coats, family tokens, patched shade cloths and route-worn gear; visually cohesive without supernatural anatomy

C_sun_isabella.name: Isabella Torres
C_sun_isabella.role: Mirage Club performer and respected community figure whose private grievance breaks the club's rule against demanding real identities
C_sun_isabella.voice: composed, intimate, emotionally specific; longer sentences when anger finally outruns control
C_sun_isabella.visual: elegant frontier performer in dark layered stagewear with worn metallic detail, practical boots and carefully controlled posture

C_sun_preacher.name: Samuel Hayes
C_sun_preacher.role: Raina's advance social engineer, traveling ahead to seed expectations around Brandon while possessing a genuine pastoral instinct that complicates the manipulation
C_sun_preacher.voice: warm, associative, disarming; capable of steering a conversation without sounding like a pitch
C_sun_preacher.visual: weathered middle-aged man in sun-faded layered clothes, worn coat, scarf and practical route gear

C_sun_sandrider.name: Sand Rider
C_sun_sandrider.role: ordinary Cinder Basin scout and member of the Los Lagartos community; not the later distant Rider mystery
C_sun_sandrider.voice: brief, concrete observations; dry familiarity with Lagartos custom
C_sun_sandrider.visual: lean weathered ordinary human scout in layered canvas, wrapped face protection, sun goggles and wind-worn travel gear; visually distinct from the later distant Rider

C_sun_brute.name: Marcus Kovacs
C_sun_brute.role: Last Drop strongman who uses public punishment, reputation and the Brannock story to make local control look inevitable
C_sun_brute.voice: plain, direct, threatening without ornament; grows louder when attention leaves him
C_sun_brute.visual: large heavy-built man in work-worn frontier clothes with improvised protective gear

C_sun_raina.name: Raina James
C_sun_raina.role: pursuer and investigator following Brandon's contradictory story; initially believes he is hiding a human past and uses the Preacher to pressure that truth into the open
C_sun_raina.voice: controlled, exact, skeptical; concrete even when the evidence stops cooperating
C_sun_raina.visual: weathered woman in fitted tracking leathers, polished field boots, brass optics, map case and compact notebooks

C_sun_forger.name: Dylan Sheets
C_sun_forger.role: weathered traveler and occasional Cadre figure whose practical craft can make a local problem more specific without becoming an infrastructure plot
C_sun_forger.visual: weathered traveler in layered work clothes with chalk, compass, hand tools and a dust-dark coat

C_sun_hanging_man.name: Tomas
C_sun_hanging_man.role: Last Drop local being publicly hanged by Marcus when Brandon intervenes; survives and later becomes one of the people who knows Brandon by his real name
C_sun_hanging_man.visual: dusty local man in ordinary work clothes, rope-burned neck, exhausted and barely able to stand

C_sun_scarred_patron.name: Scarred patron
C_sun_scarred_patron.role: Last Drop local primed to expect Brannock and the first person in the series to force an identity onto Brandon
C_sun_scarred_patron.visual: sunburned frontier local with a pale cheek scar, rolled sleeves and a heavy drinking coat

C_sun_relay_boy.name: Boy
C_sun_relay_boy.role: relay-settlement child Samuel tends while Eva discovers him
C_sun_relay_boy.visual: dusty local child with a freshly scraped hand and ordinary patched frontier clothes

C_sun_rider.name: The Rider
C_sun_rider.role: later-stage distant figure whose repeated spatial behavior becomes the first element the group cannot comfortably reduce to social manipulation, coincidence or ordinary pursuit
C_sun_rider.voice: No confirmed dialogue in early appearances.
C_sun_rider.visual: single distant mounted or rider-like silhouette against the Sunfields horizon; details remain unreadable at first, with no visible glow or spectral anatomy

C_sun_mary_bell.name: Mary Bell
C_sun_mary_bell.role: Bellweather family member trying to honor her dead mother without turning Brandon into the missing brother she wishes had returned
C_sun_mary_bell.voice: direct, tired, emotionally open when certainty fails
C_sun_mary_bell.visual: sun-weathered woman in practical mourning clothes with rolled sleeves and a family token at her throat

C_sun_owen_bell.name: Owen Bell
C_sun_owen_bell.role: Bellweather sibling who wants the absent Nathan to settle a disputed family promise
C_sun_owen_bell.visual: broad-shouldered frontier man in ordinary family work clothes, dark vest and weathered boots

C_sun_nessa_rowan.name: Nessa Rowan
C_sun_nessa_rowan.role: young Rowan Hold woman chosen for a family responsibility she is competent to perform but does not consent to inherit
C_sun_nessa_rowan.voice: clear, impatient with affectionate coercion, warmer once people accept her decision
C_sun_nessa_rowan.visual: young adult woman with a practical travel bag, sun-browned work clothes and ink-stained fingers from family ledgers

C_sun_ada_rowan.name: Ada Rowan
C_sun_ada_rowan.role: Nessa Rowan parent and family organizer who sincerely believes responsibility should follow trust and competence
C_sun_ada_rowan.voice: firm, familial, reasonable even while overreaching
C_sun_ada_rowan.visual: middle-aged woman in durable household work clothes with ledger keys and sun-worn hands

C_sun_alec_damon.name: Alec Damon
C_sun_alec_damon.role: elderly Saint Oren resident dying with an unresolved relationship to his daughter
C_sun_alec_damon.voice: weak but lucid; dry when energy permits
C_sun_alec_damon.visual: elderly man in simple local clothes, physically frail but not visually mystified

C_sun_kayla_simmons.name: Kayla Simmons
C_sun_kayla_simmons.role: Saint Oren community host who treats the travelers as people rather than phenomena
C_sun_kayla_simmons.voice: practical, hospitable, lightly skeptical of drama
C_sun_kayla_simmons.visual: middle-aged community host in plain sun-faded clothes with an apron or work wrap

C_sun_marty_francis.name: Marty Francis
C_sun_marty_francis.role: Rookery host whose local knowledge exposes how easily travelers mistake unfamiliar people for a pattern
C_sun_marty_francis.voice: wry, socially fluent, specific about people he actually knows
C_sun_marty_francis.visual: weathered middle-aged man in layered market clothes with keys, tabs and parcels constantly changing hands

C_sun_rachael_hughes.name: Rachael Hughes
C_sun_rachael_hughes.role: old Glasshouse friend who knows Jessie well enough to recognize the difference between leaving and vanishing
C_sun_rachael_hughes.voice: warm, teasing, unsentimental; willing to say the uncomfortable personal thing plainly
C_sun_rachael_hughes.visual: woman near Jessie in age, relaxed frontier clothes, easy posture and expressive face

C_sun_maela_crow.name: Maela Crow
C_sun_maela_crow.role: Hushwater resident carrying a promise to deliver a sealed packet to Andrew Keane
C_sun_maela_crow.visual: older woman in modest household clothes with a carefully wrapped cloth packet
